title: Impulse Space media slot
description: A media slot that a real image or video fills like object-fit: cover. Empty, it is a flat muted surface with a faint glow rising from its foot (or, as a 'render', a soft glow square for a product cut-out), so it reads plainly as a placeholder.
notes: size and round it from outside (aspect-*, h-full, rounded-lg); it fills its box
